name: Runtime Economy Activation Checkpoint
required_sequence: Compile with zero errors in exactly Unity 6000.5.9f1
Retain passing evidence and set only the four supported verification flags
Review a narrow live-wiring change for GameState, ScreenRouter, Match3Board, and RuntimeBootstrap
Keep runtimeActivationApproved false while wiring and re-verification are incomplete
Re-run compilation, Editor self-tests, EditMode tests, and PlayMode tests after wiring
Set runtimeActivationApproved true only in the reviewed release candidate
Re-run the complete verification set after the manifest change
activation_acceptance: One atomic candidate commit for each live economy operation
Stable domain keys and explicit restart behavior
Entry cost and level-attempt behavior cannot split
Booster debit and recovery cannot duplicate or lose inventory
Unknown, insufficient, negative, duplicate, and overflowing operations fail without mutation
Daily, first-clear, double, mail, and development-mock grants cannot bypass their reviewed entitlement rules
Existing version-6 saves retain balances, inventory, progression, and claim markers
No starting-balance rebase, schema migration, or automatic grant
No store, ad, analytics, backend, cloud, or remote-config SDK
release_blocker: Any false verification flag, absent final approval, unreviewed live wiring, catalog binding mismatch, or Unity version mismatch keeps the frozen legacy policy and blocks runtime activation.
